item.text: {"summary":"Draft is mostly coherent, but it must not publish with resolver fields that diverge from the canonical ledger contract without an explicit review decision.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"blocking","summary":"The draft changes resolutionDate to 2026-07-10 and resolutionSourceUrl to the July 10 Daily page, while the canonical ledger contract specifies resolutionDate/source URL fields tied to dq260605a and the expected release window ending 2026-07-09.","actionRequested":"Either align the JSON resolver fields to the canonical ledger contract, or explicitly flag this as a ledger discrepancy for human catalog correction before publication; do not silently publish mismatched resolver fields."},{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The move from the 6.6 persistence prior to a 6.7 point estimate rests on a vague '+0.05 rounding judgment' after stated adjustment components net to zero.","actionRequested":"Replace the rounding judgment with a concrete stated update, or keep the point at the rounded persistence-implied value if no material update is justified."},{"rubricItem":"interval","severity":"warning","summary":"The 80% interval is based on only four Jan-May 2026 monthly changes, which is a very small realized-volatility sample.","actionRequested":"Use a longer same-series monthly change sample if available, or explicitly justify why the short 2026 sample is sufficient for the interval width."}],"optionalSuggestions":["State whether the forecast was made before the July 10, 2026 release time to remove any leakage concern.","Keep the reasoning discrepancy note, but mirror the final decision consistently in the top-level JSON fields."]}
